name: RAA Membership
description: The complete RAA member experience from account creation through to ongoing engagement, covering digital self-service, insurance, roadside, and member benefits.

stages.name: Join & Onboard
stages.description: The new member discovers RAA, decides to join, creates an account, and receives their membership card.
actions: Visit raa.com.au and explore membership options
thoughts: How much is membership?
What do I get as a member?
Is roadside assist worth it?

painPoints.description: The membership benefits page lists over 50 partner discounts but doesn't personalise or prioritise them. New members don't know where to start.

opportunities.description: Show a personalised 'Your top 5 benefits' based on location, age group, and products held immediately after joining

stages.name: Set Up Account
stages.description: The member logs into My Account for the first time, reviews their dashboard, and explores their products.
actions: Click Log in to My Account
View My Account dashboard for the first time
thoughts: Where do I log in?
What was my password?
What does My Account actually let me do?

painPoints.description: No social login option (Google, Apple). Members must create and remember a separate RAA password. 6 of 8 participants in the March 2026 usability test expected social login.
The login page has no indication of what My Account lets you do, reducing motivation for first-time visitors who aren't sure it's worth logging in.
62% of My Account sessions end on the dashboard without navigating deeper. Members check their summary and leave — suggesting the dashboard isn't prompting meaningful action.

opportunities.description: Add social login (Google, Apple) to reduce friction and eliminate password management
Add value proposition messaging on the login page explaining what members can do in My Account

stages.name: Manage Products
stages.description: The member manages their personal details, updates payment information, and navigates their product portfolio.
actions: Click through to individual policy details
thoughts: How do I change my address?
Is my payment card still valid?
When does my policy renew?

painPoints.description: Changing address requires updating it separately for membership AND each insurance policy — it's not synced. This generates 34 support tickets per month and is the single highest-volume complaint for My Account.
No confirmation email or notification after updating payment details. Members don't know if the change worked and sometimes submit it twice.
Policy detail pages show raw policy numbers and dates without context. Members don't know what their excess is without clicking through multiple pages.

opportunities.description: Sync address changes across membership and all policies in a single update
Send a confirmation email after any detail change with a summary of what was updated

stages.name: Get Insurance
stages.description: The member goes through the insurance lifecycle — quoting, purchasing, renewing, and (if needed) claiming. This stage represents the entire Insurance sub-journey.
actions: Lodge a claim if an incident occurs
thoughts: Is RAA competitive?
How much do I actually need to insure for?
Why did my premium go up?
Can I lodge this claim online?

painPoints.description: No online claim lodgement exists. The 'Make a claim' button in My Account directs to a phone number, despite 7 of 8 test participants expecting a digital form.
No explanation of why premiums changed at renewal. 6 of 8 participants felt the increase was 'unfair or unexplained' — all 6 said a simple explanation would have made it acceptable.
8 of 8 participants in the quote flow had no indication of how many steps or how long the process would take before starting.

opportunities.description: Build an online claim lodgement form accessible from My Account — the highest-impact digital gap in the entire member experience
Add a progress indicator to the quote flow and a 'Why your premium changed' explanation at renewal

stages.name: Use Benefits
stages.description: The member discovers and uses their membership benefits, including roadside assist, partner discounts, RAA Rewards, and travel services.
actions: Scroll to member benefits on the dashboard
thoughts: What discounts can I get?
Is my membership paying for itself?
How do I use my card in store?

painPoints.description: The benefits section is below the fold on the dashboard. Analytics show most members don't scroll past their products, so many are unaware of the discounts they're entitled to.
Clicking RAA Rewards or competitions opens in a new tab on an external site, losing the My Account context and creating a jarring experience.

opportunities.description: Surface a personalised 'Top benefit for you' card above the product list on the dashboard, based on member location and interests

stages.name: Renew & Retain
stages.description: The member faces renewal decisions across membership and insurance products. This is the key retention moment.
actions: Log in to review new premium
Decide to accept, adjust, or cancel
thoughts: Has my premium gone up again?
Should I shop around this year?
What if I just let it auto-renew and check later?

painPoints.description: Renewal emails don't show the new premium amount. 18 support tickets in Q1 2026 came from members who didn't know their premium had changed until after auto-renewal charged their account.
Auto-renewal happens by default with no proactive 7-day reminder. Some members don't realise they've been renewed until they see the charge on their bank statement.
There's no in-flow option to adjust cover at renewal. Members who want to change their excess or sum insured must call or start a new quote.

opportunities.description: Include the new premium amount and year-on-year change in the renewal email — and send a clear 7-day reminder before auto-renewal with a one-click option to pause or cancel
Allow members to adjust excess, sum insured, and optional covers online during the renewal window without starting a new quote

stages.name: Get Help
stages.description: The member needs assistance — lodging a claim, raising a complaint, or accessing roadside. This is the most critical and currently most painful part of the experience.
actions: Navigate to 'Make a claim' or 'Contact us' in My Account
Call the claims line or support number
Follow up for claim status updates
thoughts: Can I sort this online?
How long will I be waiting?
Why can't I see what's happening with my claim?

painPoints.description: All claim lodgement requires a phone call. The 'Make a claim' button in My Account directs to a phone number — there is no online path at all.

No online claim tracking. Members cannot see the status of their claim in My Account. 6 of 6 interview participants said this was their biggest frustration — all had called multiple times for updates.
Communication during claims is inconsistent — some updates arrive by email, some by phone, some by letter. There is no single thread or history in My Account.

opportunities.description: Build an online claim lodgement form in My Account — this is the single highest-impact digital gap in the entire RAA member experience
Build a claim tracker in My Account showing the current status, next steps, and expected timeline — and consolidate all claim communications into a single thread with push notifications

insights.description: Claims NPS is -12 versus Quote to Buy NPS of +45. The post-purchase experience is dramatically worse than pre-purchase. RAA's digital capability is strongest at the point of sale and weakest at the moment of need.

The address sync issue (updating separately across membership and each insurance policy) generates 34 support tickets per month — the single highest-volume complaint category across all My Account interactions.

62% of My Account sessions end on the dashboard without navigating deeper. Members check their summary and leave — meaning the value of deeper features (policy details, benefits, documents) is going unrealised for the majority of users.

The digital self-service experience is strong pre-purchase (8 digital stages in the quote flow) and absent post-purchase (0 digital stages for claims). This inversion is the core experience gap: RAA invests in acquisition, not retention.

18 support tickets in Q1 2026 came from members who didn't know their premium had changed until after auto-renewal. These members had already been charged — this is a trust issue as much as a UX issue.

Member benefits (discounts, rewards, roadside) are the highest-satisfaction touchpoint in the member experience, yet they are the least surfaced in My Account — sitting below the fold and hidden behind an external site redirect.

changelog.description: Parent journey map created with aggregated data across My Account, Insurance, and all sub-journeys
